manage.removeMessage: It disappears for the whole family, with who plays it and their settings. A pack goes with its levels, except those another pack holds.
manage.removeForget: Also erase what everyone learned and the stats
manage.removeForgetOff: Otherwise, everything comes back if you install it again.
manage.removeForgetOn: Progress and played games will be lost for good.
manage.catalogueHelp: The packs that come with Hopla. A pack installs all its levels, including those its updates add.
manage.importHelp: Choose the file received from another family, or paste its text (hopla-module/1 format).
manage.noneHelp: Install a pack from the catalogue, then choose who plays it.
manage.totalHelp: The cap counts the {{units}} of all games together, over a day. Leave empty for none.
manage.familyHelp: These settings hold for everyone, except for who has their own in the pack. Leave empty to keep the author's. Stars: ★ at the threshold, ★★ from 90 %, ★★★ with no mistake.
manage.readAloudHelp: What the device says in the packs made to be read aloud. Everything: the question, then each answer on the first tap (a second tap chooses it).
manage.firstNameHelp: For the questions about their first name (first letter, letters in order…). Empty: the first word of their name in Hopla.
manage.firstNameFor: First name of {{name}} in the games
manage.gradingHelp: The answer time grades a quick answer as easy on its own. With the buttons, you pick Hard or Easy after a right answer; Continue counts it as good. By account: the buttons for a parent, the time for a child.
manage.reviewsShort: At most {{most}} questions a day · {{bonus}} {{units}} bonus
manage.reviewsHelp: The daily reviews gather the questions due in every pack. Past the most, the rest waits for the next day (handy after the holidays). The bonus comes once a day, when everything is reviewed. Leave empty to keep the default.
manage.addPack: Add a pack from the catalogue

voices.title: Voices of this device
voices.help: The voice that reads the questions in Learn. Each device has its own voices, so this choice is only for this device. Automatic takes the most natural voice installed.
voices.noVoice: No voice in this language on this device.

sample.fr: Bonjour ! Combien font sept fois huit ?

voices.getBetterHelp: Apple does not lend Siri voices to web pages: download a “Premium” or “Enhanced” voice, then open Hopla again.

ipad.title: iPad and iPhone
ipad.steps: Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content › Voices › French: tap a voice (Audrey, Thomas, Aurélie…) then download its Premium or Enhanced version. Same in English for the English packs.

mac.title: Mac
mac.steps: System Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content › System Voice › Manage Voices: download a French Premium or Enhanced voice.

android.title: Android
android.steps: Settings › Accessibility › Text-to-speech › Google engine › Install voice data › French: choose a voice.

windows.title: Windows computer
windows.steps: In Edge, the “Natural” (online) voices are already there. Otherwise: Settings › Time & language › Speech › Add voices.

voices.serverHelp: The « Server » voices are made by the Hopla server: very natural, but they need the network; offline, the device uses its own voice.

hardSample.fr: au|un|A|le hibou|maman|lapin|un lion|la partie en couleur

list.nothing: No pack matches the search or the filters.

reports.help: Open the list to correct the questions, or export a file to send.
reports.generated: Question made by the game: it can't be corrected here. Export it to have it corrected.

recre.title: Break time!
recre.pick: Pick a little game. It earns no hops, only records!
recre.notSaved: The score could not be saved.

about.train: Pick up the carrots without bumping.

about.panier: Catch the carrots, dodge the stones.

help.train: Swipe or use the arrows to turn.
help.bulles: Aim with your finger and let go to shoot.
help.panier: Slide the basket left and right.
help.terriers: Tap each bunny coming out of its burrow.
help.sequence: Watch, then tap the colours in the same order.

settings.title: Break time
settings.help: A little game after a few games of Learn played well (at least 2 stars). It earns no hops.
settings.bank: Break time from the shop waiting: {{time}}

recre.bankPick: Your reward: break time! The clock only runs while you play.

trial.title: Try the games
trial.help: Trial games: no record, and {{name}}'s break does not change. The games follow their settings.

test.offer: Already know a bit? Take the test: it opens the chapters you know right away.
test.rules: 8 questions per chapter, 7 right answers to open it · no hops
test.title: Test · {{pack}}
test.howItWorks: Seven right answers out of eight open the chapter. Every chapter of the level is tested, even after a mistake.
test.noHops: The test gives no hops and does not count in the reviews.
test.nonePassed: Nothing opened this time, {{name}}, but you can try again whenever you like.

pack.familyHelp: Packs written here or received from another family. Turn them on in By person for whoever plays them.
pack.familyNone: Write a small pack of your own, such as this week's spelling words, or import one from another family.
pack.importHint: Import: a file received from another family, or its pasted text.
pack.notEditable: This pack can't be edited here: it holds exercises the editor can't write. Export it to change the file.
pack.name: Pack name
pack.subject: Subject
pack.openAt: when the chapter before is known at {{value}}%
